Name: Shabby Chic Elliott
Author: ebuaskew
Description:
All of Elliott's dramatic flare but slightly toned down to suit his shabby beach shack lifestyle. I think the beard suits Elliott surprisingly well, but you can decide for yourself which you prefer in the config file -- both options are available for the beach and 1.6 winter outfit as well! 

My edits include:
[list]
[*]Slight adjustments to beach portrait
[*]Touched up hair & shading
[*]Matching outfit for sprites
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Elliott with a new standard outfit and optional beard.
